newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Motorola trades higher.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Motorola trades higher.

text.p: Technology giant Motorola Inc was trading higher before Wednesday's market opening after it posted better-than expected second-quarter operating results.

Traders said Motorola was trading at 86-1/4, up from a Tuesday closing price of 82-3/4. The company said after the market's close Tuesday that it earned $0.62 a share, compared with a First Call consensus estimate of $0.56.

Wells Fargo and Co was bid at 250 from a closing price of 279. The company said Wednesday its second-quarter earnings would not meet analysts' expectations and would be about $1 below analysts' consensus estimate of $3.53 a share.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc was trading at 37-3/8. The shares closed Tuesday at 39-1/8 and fell in after-hours trading to 36-5/8.
Advanced Micro said Tuesday it would post weaker-than-expected second-quarter profits.
Intimate Brands Inc was trading at 22, up from a closing price of 20-15/16. The specialty retailer said second-quarter earnings should exceed analysts' estimates.
Control Data Systems Inc was trading at 19-3/4 from a closing price of 15-11/16. The company said Wednesday it had agreed to be acquired by CDSI Holding Corp for $20.25 a share.
